name: Prusa MK4 (Buddy)
startScript:
M201 X4000 Y4000 Z200 E2500 ; maximum accelerations, mm/sec^2
M203 X180 Y180 Z12 E80 ; maximum feedrates, mm/sec
M204 P4000 R1200 T4000 ; print, retract and travel acceleration, mm/sec^2
M205 X8.00 Y8.00 Z2.00 E10.00 ; jerk limits, mm/sec
M205 S0 T0 ; minimum extruding and travel feed rate, mm/sec
M221 S100 ; extrusion multiplier 100% — Grackle's E values are the truth
M107 ; part fan off until a Fan operation asks otherwise
endScript:
G1 E-2 F2100 ; retract the filament tip so it stops oozing
G1 X241 Y170 F3600 ; park the head at the back-right corner
G4 ; drain the planner queue before the motors let go
M900 K0 ; reset linear advance
M142 S36 ; reset the heatbreak target temperature
M84 X Y E ; steppers off — Z holds the bed where it is
